newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi says Italy must strive to meet Maastricht.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi says Italy must strive to meet Maastricht.

text.p: Italy's Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said that Italy must make the maximum effort to meet the financial criteria of the Maastricht Treaty on European economic and monetary union.
Writing in La Repubblica newspaper he said that failure to comply with the Treaty, aimed at creating a single European currency by 1999, would have negative consequences.

He wrote that Italy "must continue to make the maximum effort to reach the Maastricht criteria," and he underlined that these criteria "are not a barrier, but reference parameters of figures and trends".

Under the Maastricht Treaty on European integration, governments should aim to bring their 1997 budget deficits close to three percent of total output, and put their outstanding debt level on a sustainable path towards 60 percent of GDP.
